title: Canned job is added without its inactive parts and one warning names them
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A], [Part-B] = two tracked parts set inactive in Setup; [Part-C] = one tracked part, active. Each quantity 4.
  • Data: [Job-1] = a canned job holding [Part-A], [Part-B] and [Part-C] (3 parts). [WO-1] = an open work order without lines.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNED A), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNED A).
  3. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNED B), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-02), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  4. [Part-B] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-02); [Desc-B] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNED B).
  5. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNED C), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-03), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  6. [Part-C] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-03); [Desc-C] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNED C).
  7. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order"; in Customer click Add and create a customer (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNEDSRC Customer"); in Asset click Add and create a unit (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNEDSRC-UNIT"); click Create.
  8. [WO-0] = the work order number shown at the top left (e.g. S2-1234).
  9. On [WO-0] click "New Line", type Title (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNEDSRC line"), click "Save & Close". [Line-0] = that line. Click "Approve" on [Line-0].
  10. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-A] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  11. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-B] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  12. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Request part", type [Part-C] in Part Number, pick the row that shows "Inventory Qty", set Quantity to 1 and click "Save Part".
  13. On [Line-0] open the line's ⋮ menu, click "Save as canned line" and save it under the line's title. [Job-1] = that canned job name.
  14. Go to Work Orders, click "New Work Order", create the customer "ZZAUTOTEST PL CANNED Customer" and unit "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-CANNED-UNIT", click Create. [WO-1] = that work order number.
  15. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  16. Set [Part-B] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-B], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  17. Check the setup worked: on [WO-1] click "New Line" and type the start of [Job-1] in Title: the suggestion shows "Total Parts: 3"; close the dialog. [Part-A] and [Part-B] are on the Inactive tab, [Part-C] on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Open [WO-1].
  2. Click "New Line".
  3. Type the start of [Job-1] in Title.
  4. Pick the [Job-1] suggestion.
  5. Click "Save & Close".
  6. Read the warning at the bottom right.
  7. Wait 10 seconds.
  8. Click "Close" on the warning.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: The suggestion reads [Job-1] with "Total Parts: 3".
  • Step 5: [WO-1] gets a new line [Job-1] holding one part, [Part-C]. [Part-A] and [Part-B] are not on it.
  • Step 6: Exactly one warning shows (one for the whole canned job, not one per part): "These parts are inactive and were not added: [Part-A], [Part-B]."
  • Step 7: The warning is still on screen after 10 seconds.
  • Step 8: The warning closes.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v26 (Ready for dev), S9-R9, S9-R10, read 8 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 6.4 (A canned job that holds it) and 6.5 (The canned job leaves it out; its toast wording is the older one, the PRD wins). Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists). Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan", 7 Oct 2026 (informs, never overrules), §6 Phase 7.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R9: “Applying a canned job adds the job without its inactive parts.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Canned job leaves out inactive parts): “"These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Canned job leaves out inactive parts): “Warning toast, one per canned job, stays until closed”
  • Tech plan (Parts Lifecycle Update, 7 Oct 2026), §6 Phase 7 browser-walk: “a canned job containing it and a second inactive part shows one warning naming both”
